A skeletal lich in rotted royal finery, a crown fused to its bare skull, clutching a staff topped with a screaming soul-trapped skull, green light burning in its empty sockets.
An armored death-knight in black corroded plate edged with frost, a notched runed greatsword wreathed in cold blue flame, a tattered cloak hanging from skeletal shoulders.
A towering bone-dragon assembled from countless fused skeletons, four clawed legs and vast wings of stretched bone-membrane, eye-sockets glowing with necrotic green fire.
A vampire lord in deep crimson and black robes trimmed with grave-moth lace, pale clawed hands folded, his ancient eyes gleaming red beneath a crown of blackened silver thorns.
A mummified pharaoh-king risen from obsidian sarcophagus, body wrapped in crumbling gold-threaded bandages, a crook and flail of corroded electrum crossed at his chest, desiccated eyes burning amber.
A wraith-lord of boiling shadow and shredded darkness, a jagged spectral crown hovering above where a skull might be, twin voids for eyes radiating cold violet radiance.
A ghostly revenant knight in translucent rusted armor, a phantom lance crackling with pale lightning, the grim visage of his death-wound still carved across his spectral face.
A necromancer in bone-trimmed black robes with a hood of stitched death-shroud, arms raised wide, skeletal hands crackling with purple lightning as risen dead claw upward from cracked earth.
A colossal flesh-golem of stitched and mismatched cadavers, iron bolts fused through its neck and spine, crude runes branded into rotting grey skin, one eye vacant, one burning orange.
A banshee-queen of keening white mist, her gown a tattered funeral shroud trailing into fog, long hair streaming like smoke, hollow mouth stretched in a silent eternal scream.
A skeletal warlord enthroned on a throne of interlocked enemy skulls, finger-bones curled over the armrests, a rusted iron war-crown atop his bare skull, radiating cold authority.

An undead sorceress wreathed in soul-fire, her blackened bone-laced robes billowing upward, hollowed cheeks framed by spectral silver hair, twin orbs of blue soul-flame orbiting her outstretched palms.
A plague-bishop in corroded ceremonial vestments of rotted gold cloth, a censer swinging black miasma on a chain of vertebrae, sunken face half-hidden beneath a cracked burial mask.
A drowned revenant admiral in barnacled naval coat, seaweed tangled through exposed ribs, a rusted cutlass dripping black brine, pale blue corpse-light flickering behind his waterlogged eye-sockets.
A lich-empress seated on a throne of obsidian bone-shards, her decayed gown spreading like dark petals, skeletal fingers adorned with soul-gem rings, a veil of shadow shrouding her dread face.
A skeletal centaur-lord of fused equine and human bones, four hooves striking sparks of black flame, wielding a massive barbed lance dripping necrotic ichor, eye-sockets blazing twin crimson fires.
An undead giant of crumbling grey stone-fused bone, standing three men tall, chains of rusted iron binding its wrists, a shattered crown embedded in its skull, roaring silent darkness.
A shadow-assassin revenant draped in tattered black leather, twin daggers of pure shadow-bone extended, face nothing but a smooth pale death-mask, darkness pooling outward from his every silent step.

A bone-golem knight of pure architectural skeleton, ribs interlocked into chest-armor, finger-bones fused into gauntlets, a tower shield of shoulder-blades raised, pulsing with a steady violet heartbeat of dark magic.

A lich-shaman in feathered burial robes of rotted black plumage, a skull-topped totem staff carved with screaming faces, sunken eyes gleaming amber, risen ancestral spirits swirling like smoke around him.
A spectral death-judge in the tattered robes of a high court, a scale of bone and shadow floating beside him, one eye socket sealed by a rusted coin, the other blazing cold white.
A dessicated demon-bound warlord in cracked obsidian armor fused to his rotting flesh, a greatsword of black iron notched by a thousand battles, twin horns of dark bone jutting from his helm.

A fungal lich entwined in pale death-caps and grey mycelium threading through its hollow ribcage, robes reduced to mulch and spore-silk, eyes replaced by glowing bioluminescent rot-blooms pulsing sickly green.
An undead sea-witch rising from black water, coral and barnacles fused to her bleached bones, a trident of sharpened ribcage-spars in her grip, brine and darkness pouring from her open jaw.

A skeletal dragon-rider atop a bone-wing serpent, both rider and mount fused at the pelvis into one continuous skeleton, twin staffs of crackling death-energy raised, dominating the ashen sky above a ruined kingdom.
